# 4LOG

> 4LOG is a trending fashion brand creating bold T-shirts and apparel for people who do it anyway. From talk to takeover.

## Canonical URLs
- Homepage: https://4log.in/
- About 4LOG: https://4log.in/about
- T-Shirts Collection: https://4log.in/collections/t-shirts

## Collections & Worlds
- Nivora: Urban tactical & brutalist styling
- Vayren: Underground rebellion & industrial aesthetics
- Aurvia: Organic futurism & fluid structural designs
- Astera: Celestial & cosmic fashion landscapes
- Manifera: Art-gallery manifesto & expressive silhouettes

## Brand Philosophy
"Do It Anyway. From Talk to Takeover."
